name: pe2-libui
prompt:
Kreative Studio web UI (STU-PE2, the Animation part of the Pose tab). Plain browser JavaScript, no modules, no libraries, no build step. Write public/js/anim-library.js: exports and saved clips of the Animation section in the Pose tab. One IIFE with 'use strict'. It runs after public/js/pose-anim.js, which sets window.KKAnimEditor = {clip(), setClip(c), error(msg)} on DOMContentLoaded; set up on DOMContentLoaded too (or at once when the document is already loaded). Use the global toast(message, {kind}) when typeof toast === 'function'. Elements by id: anim-hands, anim-dl-bvh, anim-dl-glb, anim-dl-strip, anim-dl-frames, anim-name, anim-save, anim-library, pose-yaw. - view() = {width: 256, height: 384, yaw: +document.getElementById('pose-yaw').value || 0}. - async request(method, url, body): fetch(url, {method, headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, body: body && JSON.stringify(body)}); when !res.ok: let msg = res.statusText; try msg = (await res.json()).error || msg; throw new Error(msg). Return res. - exportAs(format): KKAnimEditor.error(''); res = await request('POST', '/api/anim/export', {clip: KKAnimEditor.clip(), format, hands: #anim-hands checked, view: view(), name: #anim-name value.trim() || 'clip'}); name = (/filename="([^"]+)"/.exec(res.headers.get('Content-Disposition') || '') || [])[1] || 'clip'; blob = await res.blob(); a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob); a.download = name; document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove(); setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href), 2000). Errors -> KKAnimEditor.error(e.message). Buttons: anim-dl-bvh -> 'bvh', anim-dl-glb -> 'glb', anim-dl-strip -> 'strip', anim-dl-frames -> 'frames'. - save (#anim-save click): name = #anim-name value trimmed; empty -> KKAnimEditor.error('Give the clip a name.') and return. await request('POST', '/api/anims', {name, clip: KKAnimEditor.clip(), view: view(), hands: #anim-hands checked, provenance: {source: 'editor'}}); toast('Clip saved', {kind: 'success'}); await refresh(). Errors -> KKAnimEditor.error(e.message). - refresh(): {anims} = await (await request('GET', '/api/anims')).json(); clear #anim-library; none -> one
